title: US-China talks on trade, AI between Trump, Xi beckon
summary: The presidents of the world's two largest economies are in Washington for what Donald Trump has billed a "big day." Bilateral trade, AI and geopolitics are all on the menu, as the UN General Assembly…

image.caption: Donald and Melania Trump greet Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at Joint Base Andrews, MarylandImage: Kevin Lamarque/REUTERS

blocks.text: Trump, Xi set for talks and a state dinner on Thursday

blocks.caption: Security staff started work early around the White House on Thursday, even with some time to go until the political appointments ramped upImage: Mark Schiefelbein/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: Welcome back as police and security staff in Washington gear up for an even higher-profile day than usual on Thursday.
Talks between leaders of the US and China on Thursday are set to culminate in a state dinner at the White House this evening, attended by various tech executives.
US President Donald Trump told his online acolytes that a "big day with President Xi of China" beckoned in his first social media utterance on Thursday.
He said that artificial intelligence or machine learning would "be a big topic of discussion."
But, mirroring his comments at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, Trump said he wanted to "leave it exactly where it is."
He said that the US' "guardrail" for AI was its own Department of Justice, implying little interest in international or cooperative efforts to guard against any potential risks.
"That is China's position also," Trump asserted, though Xi Jinping is expected to deliver remarks of his own later.

blocks.caption: As the Trump administration rolled out the red carpet for Xi, activists called for the release of political prisoners in China Image: Kylie Cooper/REUTERS

blocks.text: Meanwhile, early morning reports from Washington suggest the White House was yet to react to the overnight court order demanding that it allow reporters from CNN, MSNOW and Politico back into the building, at least temporarily pending closer evalution of the case.
